formats.label: Alternating
formats.description: Each word three times with its translation, straight through with no pause to recall.

formats.label: Classic drill
formats.description: Each word three times with its translation, with a pause to recall the meaning the first time.

formats.label: Say it back
formats.description: Hear the word, say it yourself in the pause, then hear it again.

formats.label: Radio lesson
formats.description: An intro, each word with an example and sometimes a remark, a quiz halfway, then every word again.

formats.label: Review
formats.description: For words you know: the meaning first, a pause to find the word, then all of them once more.

formats.label: Story
formats.description: A short story told in pieces between the words, then every word again.

family_details.label: Meditative
family_details.description: Slow and spacious: long held chords, little or no percussion.

family_details.label: Organic
family_details.description: Earthy mid-tempo pulse: marimba or piano over soft hand percussion.

family_details.label: Acoustic
family_details.description: Gentle and melodic: piano, marimba or glockenspiel over warm strings.

family_details.label: Radiant
family_details.description: The brightest and quickest: open, major-key, uplifting.

family_details.label: Acoustic flow
family_details.description: Calm and flowing: sustained piano and strings, a light pulse.

family_details.label: Playful minimal
family_details.description: Light and sparse: a few bouncy notes over a soft pad.

family_details.label: Bright organic
family_details.description: Upbeat and airy: marimba or piano with a moving bass line.

family_details.label: Gentle game
family_details.description: Quick, cheerful arpeggios, like a calm game menu.

family_details.label: Sunlit acoustic
family_details.description: Guitar, harp or plucked strings; bright and unhurried.

family_details.label: Gentle movement
family_details.description: A soft pulse carried by piano, vibraphone, ocarina or organ.

family_details.label: Playful plucked
family_details.description: Kalimba, mbira, strumstick and guitar: plucked and bouncy.

family_details.label: Bright pastoral
family_details.description: Ocarina and pizzicato strings; open, countryside feel.
